_comment: Documented divergences of the TS event surface against the event_stream corpus. Fail-closed: a failing case NOT listed here is red; a listed case that now passes is red (stale baseline). Regenerated against the engine 4.3.2 corpus (Guard-Core/guard-core#151): that regeneration pins zero envelopes for every pipeline-driven case (34 of 39), because the reference 4.3.2 event surface captures no events at the corpus seams for those drives, while the TS event surface still emits its middleware-bus and handler events. The four handler-call cases (detection_engine_callback_error, pattern_anomaly_*) and the one xfail=true advisory case are unaffected. Entries name the TS source responsible.

cases.event_stream/evt_penetration_attempt_blo: the engine 4.3.2 corpus regeneration pins zero envelopes for this drive (the reference 4.3.2 event surface captures no events at the corpus seams); the TS event surface still emits penetration_attempt at core/checks/helpers.ts; matching the 4.3.2 pin needs a TS event-surface parity item (engine change), not a runner fix
